Setup.Name: Create dynamic metrics
Setup.Description: Create metrics with name, unit and description based on the message received.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Provides the current processor temperature."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/temp"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Processor.Temperature_In_$(JsonPath('$.Processor.Unit'))"
          Description: "The current processor temperature in $(JsonPath('$.Processor.Unit'))."
          Unit: "$(JsonPath('$.Processor.Unit'))"
          Instrument: Gauge
          Value: "JSONPATH('$.Processor.Temperature')"

Metrics.Name: Processor.Temperature_In_C
Metrics.Description: The current processor temperature in C.
